newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin eases nine cents on London's fall.
newsitem.headline: KL tin eases nine cents on London's fall.

text.p: Tin price dropped nine cents to close at 14.90 ringgit ($5.96) a kg with falls in London dampening sentiment, traders said.

"A lower market in London pulled down local prices," a trader said. He said large selling interest at the opening also eased the market. Turnover was 123 tonnes against 144 on Thursday, with buying coming from Europe and Malaysia.
The local price differential over London was at $5 a tonne premium against $25 previously.
